verdict.rationale: Munito AI documents building in Python or TypeScript by pointing the OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs at its compatible APIs (change base URL, key and model ID). It also publishes an OpenAPI contract and LangChain/LlamaIndex framework guides. The evidence shows no Munito-branded first-party SDK, so SDK support relies on third-party vendor SDKs through API compatibility. Missing for 10: a Munito-owned official SDK package, SDK reference documentation and versioning, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK compatibility.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Move from the OpenAI or Anthropic SDK. Change the base URL, the key and the model ID.
Call open models on Munito AI from an empty project in cURL, Python or TypeScript, through the OpenAI-compatible or the Anthropic-compatible API.
